system.description:
He rapped his staff upon the flagstones and gentle illumination flowed forth. Mage Light is a subtle and powerful spell that dispels darkness. It can be used to call upon the simple light of a candle or the awesome light of day. Before casting, the sorcerer must indicate where the light is set to emanate from on his person: his brow, his staff, a ring on his finger, etc. Successfully casting the spell brings forth a warm light, and negates the penalty for dim light and reduces all other darkness penalties by one. Extra successes may be spent to reduce the stiffer penalties of deeper darknesses.

Obstacle: 4^. Actions: 12.

Origin: Personal | Area of Effect: Presence | Element: Heaven | Impetus: Create | Duration: Sustained | Resource Points: 16

^ When pricing this spell in resource points, it costs 4 rps per point of obstacle rather than 2.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 215
